items.title: It wasn't one of their top offseason moves, but the Spurs' re-signing Jordan McLaughlin prompted positive reactions from Paris all the way to a critter-filled spread in Boerne.
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
It wasn't one of their top offseason moves, but the Spurs' re-signing Jordan McLaughlin prompted positive reactions from Paris all the way to a critter-filled spread in Boerne.

"It put a smile on my face," Keldon Johnson said.

On the Spurs’ “ultimate pro.”

media.title: Why the Spurs are thrilled to have undersized guard Jordan McLaughlin back
media.description: The undersized guard from Southern California re-signed with the team after briefly considering a handful of other offers. His teammates and coaches are more than happy to have him back.
